answer:
More than 1 question.

You are using spark.read... This means no tracking of files already processed. You need to use readStream for that so as to avoid double-processing.

To be real safe, for the spark.read you will need a post- or pre-processing step to remove all files that have been processed. For spark.readStream use foreachBatch in the App or the approach for spark.read, i.e. scripts.

For the other options excluding DLT you need to move files to a /done with logic per microbatch. For DLT you must use a post processing external routine to move files, as foreachBatch is not compatible with DLT.

Using readSteam with .format("cloudFiles") means using AutoLoader. AutoLoader does not accept DELTA table files and transaction logs for processing, as the error message clearly states that you present.

See my figure below on the various aspects for processing, as I am preparing for the Databricks certification. And cannot remember all in 1 go without writing it down! This should help you choose and re-design your pipeline.

NB: Both DLT and AutoLoader are based on Structured Streaming; there are thus also the same limitations to consider in terms of processing capabilities (that can be done as part of post-processing).
